ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 25% coverage of high-intensity (white) linear and circular features creating a high local contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense distribution of high-intensity linear streaks and small circular spots across both lobes; no large-scale contiguous monochromatic blobs are present on the dark base pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal pixel angle of 75 degrees and a depth approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, moderate-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; notable high-amplitude peaks are visible on the distal edges of both lobes, transitioning to smoother, higher-frequency micro-notches toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge sweeping from the lateral tips to the center; convex curvature on the visible leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant clusters of high-intensity circular and ovoid pixel groups located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely packed, multi-directional high-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering over 60% of the visible ventral surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring/abrasions globally distributed across the fluke; prominent epibiotic encrustation at the distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The high-density, overlapping nature of white linear scars against the dark pigmentation creates a unique, complex textural pattern across the entire structure.
